title: The Voices Beneath the Water · Episode 1: Who Is Speaking?
description: Play as Jonathan, a Jedi on a new planet. Help a frightened girl find her mother - then discover why a familiar voice keeps calling from an empty room. Short Mandarin lines with audio, pinyin and meanings.

storyCircle.You: Jonathan arrives accustomed to protecting people from visible dangers.
storyCircle.Need: A frightened child needs help finding the source of a familiar voice.
storyCircle.Go: He follows her to the empty water store with An and Q.
storyCircle.Search: They listen, inspect the doorway and compare what each person heard.
storyCircle.Find: The real mother arrives, proving she is not trapped inside.
storyCircle.Take: Jonathan must admit he cannot yet explain the voice; he gives up easy reassurance.
storyCircle.Return: He escorts the child back to her mother rather than pursuing the sound alone.
storyCircle.Change: The child is safe, and he treats the recording as evidence to investigate, not a reason to accuse anyone.

seasonCircle.beat: Jonathan arrives as a capable Jedi, ready to protect people and investigate visible danger.
The voices and shortage reveal a deeper need: people must trust a fair process, not merely a powerful visitor.
He leaves the landing settlement with people from both communities and enters the damaged landscape and old passage.
Rescues, measurements, hiring, school and personal history make him depend on local knowledge and earned trust.
The group identifies the false voices, the deep water reserve and a workable recovery plan. Jonathan could try to control the answer himself.
He gives up unilateral control and the certainty of a familiar voice. Leaders surrender exclusive access and accept accountability; Q sacrifices its rare power cell. Cooperation carries a real cost.
The group comes back from the chamber to ordinary life: water deliveries, school, gardening and a shared table.
Jonathan can leave because the communities can check evidence, resolve complaints and share water without him. He has practiced protection through partnership rather than indispensability.

He looks eagerly down at the hilt, presses its button, and a single bright BLUE lightsaber blade rapidly extends from the TOP emitter upward, with a crisp electric ignition sound. Blue light washes his face. His eyebrows lift and his smile becomes a huge delighted grin; he gives an excited little shoulder bounce and raises the lit saber triumphantly slightly away from his face. Exuberant joy and wonder, not fighting. Keep the blade straight, attached to the hilt, and visible; only one blade, no extra limbs. Gentle cape movement and cinematic camera push-in.
